objective.description: Rank only eligible, evaluable candidates with positive immediate relief and positive net score; maximize immediate gap relief less incremental cost, interest, and season-three debt.

catalog.label: Borrower outreach
catalog.mechanism: No automatic numeric risk reduction; contact only.

catalog.label: Due-date shift
catalog.mechanism: Move first due 30 days; accrue declared simple interest for the extension.

catalog.label: Installment change
catalog.mechanism: Split principal and scheduled amount across two dates; disclosed fee and interest terms.

catalog.label: Irrigation support
catalog.mechanism: Use only a declared scenario irrigation fraction; no observed water access inferred.

catalog.label: Hypothetical assistance
catalog.mechanism: Dated cash credit, bounded by a declared scenario budget; not a program award.

catalog.label: Insurance scenario
catalog.mechanism: Payout only with explicit enrollment before cutoff, explicit trigger, and dated payout.
